//: Notes pinned to map hexes (game src/game/world/MapNotes.js). Prologue design values. `tools` maps the CDDA writing tools (flag WRITE_MESSAGE) to the ink the note is drawn in: black, blue, red, green or graphite; an unlisted tool with the flag writes black. `journals` are carried books that raise the number of notes from `capacity.loose` (the margins of the map) to `capacity.journal`. `inkPerNote` is spent only from tools with a real supply (maxCharges > 0).
